title: FACED - Finer-grained Affective Computing EEG Dataset
description: The Finer-grained Affective Computing EEG Dataset (FACED) contains 32-channel scalp EEG from 123 healthy participants who watched 28 emotion-eliciting video clips targeting nine emotion categories (four negative, four positive, and neutral). Participants gave self-reported ratings on 12 dimensions, including discrete emotions, valence, arousal, liking, and familiarity. The dataset supports cross-subject affective computing and the development of EEG-based emotion recognition algorithms. This version is converted to BIDS with events annotated by video and emotion labels.
methods_description: Participants sat 60 cm from a 22-inch LCD monitor and completed trials of a 5-second fixation cross, a video clip (roughly 30-130 s), and a 12-item self-report rating on a 0-7 scale, followed by at least 30 s of rest. Videos were shown in blocks of positive, negative, and neutral clips, with arithmetic problems between blocks to reduce carryover. EEG was recorded with a 32-channel Biosemi system placed according to the 10-20 system, sampled at 1000 Hz (92 subjects) or 250 Hz (31 subjects).
